calculation.description: Ranks assets by five-day reversal during stress, and by 20-day momentum otherwise. Stress is defined using only completed bars as ((SPX 20-day return < 0) and (VIX 5-day return > 0)) or VIX above its trailing 60-day median.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission statistics pass the benchmark gates, but annual daily IC weakened to -0.01143 in 2026; interpret with conservative uncertainty given 15-name cross-sections. Stress-conditioned five-day reversal variant was selected from a small interpretable grid.
